project_type: Next.js 16.2.4 App Router web app (React 19.2.4, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS v4 via @tailwindcss/postcss). Minimal create-next-app starter with a single static landing page.
build_system: npm (package-lock.json present). Node runtime is NOT on PATH by default in this sandbox: it is installed via nvm. Prepend PATH before any node/npm command: export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH". Available nvm node versions: v18.20.8, v20.20.2, v22.23.2, v24.19.0. Use v22.23.2.
test_framework: None. There is no test framework, no test files, and no test script in package.json. Verification is done via `npm run lint`, `npm run build`, and browser-based manual QA against the dev server.
test_command: export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && npm run lint  (no unit tests exist; lint is the closest automated check)
verification_instructions: 1) export PATH to include nvm node v22.23.2. 2) npm install. 3) npm run lint (capture warnings/errors). 4) npm run build (capture warnings/errors). 5) npm run dev in background, load http://localhost:3000 with a browser automation tool (playwright or agent-browser power). 6) Capture screenshots at desktop (1440x900), tablet (768x1024), mobile (375x667) viewports. 7) Inspect browser console and network tab. 8) Test keyboard tab order and focus indicators. If browser automation is unavailable, fall back to static analysis + build/lint and note the method used per check.
snapshot_or_generated_files: next build produces .next/ (gitignored). npm install produces node_modules/ and may create next-env.d.ts (gitignored per eslint config). No checked-in generated files. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for this Next.js version's conventions before assuming behavior (per AGENTS.md).
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET: npm install, next build, dev server, and external requests all work. Node must be sourced from nvm (not on default PATH). next/font/google fetches Geist fonts from Google at build time (works under OPEN_INTERNET). A browser automation power (playwright / agent-browser) is available for dynamic checks; if it cannot be driven, do static analysis and record which checks were dynamic vs static.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md warns this Next.js version has breaking changes vs training data; consult node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code. The deliverable here is a report, not app code, so minimal code risk. Steering: any web-app code written must use responsive Tailwind utility classes and semantic HTML.
